title: nephrodium krameri
intro: Nephrodium krameri, commonly known as the maidenhair fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Nephrodium krameri include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
